electricity_grid.applicable_region: India — national grid Combined Margin, not a Hyderabad-only value
electricity_grid.source_publisher: Central Electricity Authority (CEA), Ministry of Power
limitations: The CEA CDM CO2 Baseline Database page required authentication when checked on 16 October 2026, so no Combined Margin figure is stored as verified.
Users should paste the applicable CEA Combined Margin (or their DISCOM-published factor) into Settings. Until then, emissions from electricity are reported as not calculated.
A national CM factor must not be presented as a Telangana- or Hyderabad-specific grid intensity.

electricity_inr_per_kwh.note: Enter the energy charge from your TSSPDCL/TGNPDCL (or other DISCOM) bill. No official tariff is hardcoded.

water_inr_per_kl.note: Enter the volumetric charge from your water bill. No HMWSSB rate is hardcoded.

peak_sun_hours_hyderabad_illustrative.note: Do not use a guessed insolation figure. Users should enter a site-specific value from a measured or published solar atlas for their location.
